description:
Ever spent hours chasing down photos scattered across chat groups, email threads, and random cloud folders after a party? Partoska fixes that.

Create an event, share a link or QR code, and watch the photos roll in—from everyone, in one place, in full quality.

Perfect for weddings, birthday parties, team events, family reunions, corporate gatherings, sports matches, camps, and anywhere people take photos worth keeping.

defaultPrompt: Create an event named Linden Yard BBQ and give me an invite QR card.
Show me the favorite photos from the Linden Yard BBQ.
Find Linden Yard BBQ event and return its details.
